records.task: Trace the course of the abdominal aorta beside the vena cava.

scoreEvidence.fidelity: The raw exterior and the three long-axis cuts agree within 1.25 mm. The crop retains the superior rim and the distal taper.
scoreEvidence.form: The lower trunk retains its bend and taper in both views. The reverse close-up loses the raw slice bands. Flat ends mark the sweep crop.
scoreEvidence.readability: In the oblique view the long aorta runs beside the cava. The axial view and grayscale section confirm their relative direction.
scoreEvidence.economy: The abdominal crop falls from 18,320 to 5,790 triangles. The greatest measured turning-silhouette change from the dense field is 0.50 px.

records.disposition: Adopt for the named 3D orientation task
records.note: The native CT exemplar supports 3D exterior course and orientation. The modeled AAA case owns its lumen, wall, measurement and interpretation.

comparison.label: Previous and new abdominal and screening ports
comparison.candidateLabel: The sweep crops preserve their original limits. Inspect the lower bend in the reverse view.

views.label: Complete aorta and the two ports beside the raw label
views.candidateLabel: The arch and lower trunk lose CT slice terracing. Both crops come from the same reconstructed field.

views.label: Protected cuts through the aorta
views.candidateLabel: Long-axis contours, screening stations and artificial end caps are measured against the raw CT label.

views.label: The abdominal and screening sweeps at frame 12
views.candidateLabel: The scan and overlay retain their original bytes. The exterior supplies 3D course and orientation.

records.task: Locate the mid aorta in the CT screening sweep. The worked case supplies its own wall and caliper measurement.

scoreEvidence.fidelity: The proximal, mid and distal cuts and the crop rim pass the frozen limits. The centered mid section retains the same location anterior to the spine.
scoreEvidence.form: The lower trunk retains its bend and taper in both views. The reverse close-up loses the raw slice bands. Flat ends mark the sweep crop.
scoreEvidence.readability: At the mid station the transverse overlay locates the aorta anterior to the vertebra. The separate worked case retains its 19 mm AP example.
scoreEvidence.economy: The screening port uses 4,990 triangles and about 90 KB. The largest turning-silhouette change from the dense field is 0.50 px.

records.disposition: Adopt for the named 3D orientation task
